create.name: Kaedrich Olsen
create.bio:
Kaedrich Olsen is an author and teacher of Norse mysticism, rune work, shadow work and spirit communication, with more than thirty years of practice. He grew up in a house he describes as haunted, and as a young man trained in séance, channelling and mediumship at a Spiritualist church. He speaks of a long relationship with a group of guiding beings he calls the Whisperers, and much of his teaching draws on the Elder Futhark runes and the spiritual practices of the Old Norse.

His book Runes for Transformation (Weiser Books, 2008) presents the runes as tools for personal change rather than only for divination, pairing them with affirmation, visualisation and meditation. Through his online school he teaches courses on séance, black mirror work, psychic perception, the afterlife, protection and shadow work, alongside private mentoring. He has appeared on Gaia's Beyond Belief, Coast to Coast AM and a number of podcasts, and teaches live courses on The Shift Network, including one on Norse shadow magic.

books.title: Runes for Transformation: Using Ancient Symbols to Change Your Life
books.author: Kaedrich Olsen
books.description: A practical guide to the Elder Futhark that treats the runes as tools for personal change as well as divination. It sets out the history and meaning of each rune and pairs rune work with affirmation, visualisation and meditation.

courses.title: Norse Shadow Magic
courses.description: A live online course with Kaedrich Olsen on The Shift Network that brings together Norse mysticism, rune work and shadow work.

courses.title: Séance Certification Masterclass
courses.description: A self-paced video course on running séances: preparation, protection, communicating with spirits and closing the work safely. It includes lesson notes and guided audio practices.

courses.title: Black Mirror for Séance
courses.description: A course on using the black mirror as a ritual focus for spirit communication, with guidance on discernment and on opening and closing the work.

courses.title: Paranormal Awareness
courses.description: A course on developing subtle perception such as clairvoyance and clairsentience through regular practice, and on testing what you perceive.

courses.title: The Afterlife Codex
courses.description: A guided course exploring the spiritual realms and what Kaedrich teaches about life after death, through teaching and journeying practices.

courses.title: Field Guide to Subtle Beings and Astral Entities
courses.description: A downloadable guide to the kinds of spirits and astral beings people report meeting, what they are said to want and how they communicate.

courses.title: Viking Spirit Communication
courses.description: A course on how the Old Norse related to land spirits, ancestors and the dead, with practices for clearing space and communicating with wise beings.

courses.title: Runes for Séance
courses.description: A course on using the runes and galdr (spoken rune chants) to protect your space and support clearer spirit communication.

courses.title: Runes for Shadow Work
courses.description: A course that uses the Elder Futhark runes as a framework for shadow work, helping you notice and work with hidden patterns.

courses.title: The Veiled Path
courses.description: A nine-week online shadow work programme that combines ritual practice, runes and weekly guided practices for people on magical or pagan paths.

free_resources.title: Coexisting with the Paranormal (free eBook)
free_resources.description: A free eBook of personal accounts and practical guidance on paranormal experiences, including simple ways to protect your home and methods of spirit communication. Sent by email after signing up on his home page.
